_comment_Logging: Controls logging verbosity. Allowed values are Trace, Debug, Information, Warning, Error, Critical, and None. Default applies globally; categories such as Microsoft.AspNetCore can use a different level.
_comment_AllowedHosts: Filters HTTP requests by host. Use * to allow every host, or specify semicolon-separated host names, for example server01;server01.contoso.com;*.contoso.com;localhost. Do not include a URL scheme or port.
_comment_Branding: Controls the appearance of the web interface. LogoPath is a URL path to an image below wwwroot, for example /images/kjitlogo.png. CompanyName is the company name displayed in the interface.
_comment_ActiveDirectory: Optional values: JitConfigPath as an absolute or UNC path to JIT.config; DomainFqdn as a DNS domain such as contoso.com; DomainLdapPath such as LDAP://DC=contoso,DC=com; DefaultDomain as the default domain for manual sign-in. Omit values that are not required.
_comment_DebugLog: Optional section with Path set to an absolute or UNC file path. If Path is omitted, the service uses %APPDATA%\KjitWeb\debug.log for its service account. The DebugLog__Path environment variable overrides this value.
_comment_MutualTls: Optional client certificate validation. Enabled and CheckCertificateRevocation accept true or false. When Enabled is true, HTTPS is required and RequiredEkuOids must contain at least one valid OID. The client certificate must contain every configured EKU, for example 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.2 for Client Authentication.
